_doc: Fills 0-100K uncached load for the queue-time profile. Earlier sweeps either idled the
engine between bursts (half the light run's arrivals found 0 load) or overshot 100K. Here
sessions are held at steady levels of 5-8 (cycling 5 7 6 8 twice, ~5 min each), so the
engine stays busy with new sessions' cold turns arriving at random times but rarely backs
up past ~100K; the stopped mid run (bursts to 12-14) put 40% of its non-idle arrivals
above 100K. Side probes 1-8K new tokens at 0.4/s (~1.8K tokens/s, ~20% of the ~9K/s
